indicator_definition: Difference between the median income of people below the poverty threshold and the threshold itself, expressed as a percentage of the threshold. Measures the depth of poverty. Data from EU-SILC.
rationale: The poverty gap shows how far below the poverty line the poor are. Progress means a reduction in the gap, reflecting improved incomes among those at risk of poverty.
methodology_characteristics: Data from EU-SILC. Poverty threshold set at 60% of national median equivalised disposable income. Gap expressed as percentage of threshold. Published annually by Eurostat.
